body:
core/witness_live.h (8 tests) wires a HUNTING/FRENZIED zombie as a real live witnessed event into witness_rules.c's own tested npc_next_state; server_tick_witness/server_tick_dispatch give Citizens/The Men a real witness_state and The Men a real dispatch-and-resolve loop. Verified live + scratch integration harness. Honest finding: resolving a hunt doesn't stop the zombie itself from being witnessable, so a hunt can reopen immediately -- no elimination/LOS-loss path wired yet (NORTHSTAR.md S11).

⚓ ☃
title: Witness wiring + The Men's dispatch loop (S504-DISPATCH)
